jp_verse: 沈む錘が　青へ消えて\n\n    海は静かに　深さを隠す
en_verse: The sounding weight\nvanishes into blue—\nthe sea quietly hides its depth.

jp_verse: 掌の土に　小さな芽\n\n    春はいつでも　ここから始まる
en_verse: Within the soil\nresting in open hands—\nspring always begins here.

jp_verse: 冷たい夜へ　白い息\n\n    胸の奥まで　冬が満ちてゆく
en_verse: White breath escapes\ninto the frozen night—\nwinter fills the chest within.

jp_verse: 重い石の下で\n\n    岩は黙って裂けていた
en_verse: Beneath the weight of stone,\nthe rock split in silence.

jp_verse: 海へ突き出す　細い岬\n\n    夕陽だけが　道を照らしている
en_verse: The narrow cape\nreaches into the sea—\nonly sunset lights the way.

jp_verse: 朝の垣根に　光が落ち\n\n    小道は静かに　庭へ続いている
en_verse: Morning light falls\nupon the hedge-lined path—\nthe garden waits beyond.

jp_verse: 裂けた線を\n\n    金が埋めてひとつになる
en_verse: Gold fills the broken line,\nand it becomes one again.

jp_verse: 礼を待つ　青き圭\n\n    朝の光に　心を映す
en_verse: The jade tablet waits\nfor the coming ceremony—\nmorning light reflects the heart.

jp_verse: 封じた文を　静かに託し\n\n    朝の光が　道を照らしていた
en_verse: The sealed letter\nis quietly entrusted—\nmorning light shows the way.

jp_verse: 波の果てまで　光が伸び\n\n    空と海との　境が消える
en_verse: Light stretches outward\nto the edge of the waves—\nsea and sky become one.

jp_verse: 石畳の先に　古い寺\n\n    夕の鐘だけが　森に響いた
en_verse: Beyond the stone path\nstands the ancient temple—\nonly the evening bell resounds.

jp_verse: 古い時計の　針は進み\n\n    誰も戻れぬ　今日を刻んでゆく
en_verse: The old clock hands\ncontinue moving onward—\ncarving a day none can return to.

jp_verse: 均された土に　風が渡り\n\n    静かな畑が　空を映している
en_verse: Across the leveled earth\nthe quiet wind passes—\nthe field reflects the sky.

jp_verse: 暗い夜の中で　火は揺れて\n\n    人の心に　輪をつくる
en_verse: Within the dark night\nthe fire flickers softly—\ngathering hearts together.

jp_verse: 熱は静かに　身をめぐり\n\n    胸の奥まで　火照りが届く
en_verse: Heat moves quietly\nthrough every part of the body—\nwarmth reaches the heart.

jp_verse: 月は高く\n\n    眠れぬ夜だけが過ぎてゆく
en_verse: The moon hangs high,\nand only the sleepless night passes by.

jp_verse: 消えかけた火に　水が落ち\n\n    淡い煙だけが　空へ昇った
en_verse: Water falls softly\nupon the dying fire—\nonly pale smoke rises.

jp_verse: 小さな灯火が　夜を支え\n\n    帰る道だけを　静かに照らす
en_verse: The small lantern\nholds back the heavy night—\nlighting only the way home.

jp_verse: 朝霧の畑に　白い湯気\n\n    土は静かに　季節を育てる
en_verse: Steam drifts upward\nfrom the morning fields—\nthe earth quietly raises the seasons.

jp_verse: 燃える川辺に　黒煙が立ち\n\n    人は小さく　空を見上げる
en_verse: Dark smoke rises\nabove the burning flood—\npeople stand small beneath the sky.
